_comment: One file per NZ tax year. Every section names the source its figures were read from (data/sources.json). Do not hard-code any of these numbers in src/ or content/: copy reads them through the build context.

incomeTax.note: IRD's page shows the table 'From 1 April 2025' as the latest; no different table for 1 April 2026 was published on the page when checked. The IR340/IR341 April 2026 tables were checked against these brackets (tests/fixtures/official-examples.json).

acc.note: Rate includes GST. The same IRD page also lists 1 April 2027 to 31 March 2028; that year is not used here.

studentLoan.irdWording: IRD's student loan page says 'For the 2026 tax year the annual repayment threshold is $24,128'. IRD's Payroll calculations and business rules specification for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 (section 2.2) lists the same $24,128 threshold ('2024 onwards') and the same per-period thresholds, and the IR340/IR341 April 2026 tables build them in. Confirmed by the owner for 2026-27.

esct.note: Bands use the employee's salary or wages plus gross employer contributions for the previous tax year.

ietc.note: Only for tax code ME: NZ tax residents earning $24,000 to $70,000 who don't receive Working for Families, an income-tested benefit, NZ Super or a Veteran's Pension.

paye.method: Spec sections 5.2-5.4 and 5.6: annualise and drop cents; tax plus ACC; divide by 52 and truncate to cents; convert to the pay period and truncate. Secondary codes: whole dollars times (rate + ACC rate), truncated.
